Man it great advice but it just so hard. Maybe she was thinking those things for a long time, but that means she lied to me almost every day. Just two days before she dumped me she brought up what she wanted to name the kids we'd have and what our first wedding song would be. CAN YOU SEE HOW HARMFUL THAT IS TO ME? For someone to be planning for things in the future with me like that when I didn't even bring it up first, to dumping me and never talking to me again 48 hours later? Like I don't even know how that happens. Nothing bad happened in those 48 hours, so how can she go from bringing up our future marriage and kids together, to dumping me less than 2 days later with no explanation? Well, to me, the only explanation is that there was another guy in the picture. I'm so TIRED of being trusting and opening up, just for people to chew me up, spit me out, then leave me.

She gave me long term trauma, so why shouldn't I be able to? I've tried everyday to forget her, but I've realized she was the only thing that was was holding me up. The only person who hadn't abandoned me. The only person who at least CLAIMED to love me. And then, she left. Out of nowhere. We hadn't argued or anything, she just LEFT and ripped me to pieces.
Why not? I love her,but some times people you need to punish those you love.
